findings.text: For #74, #176, #216 and original #82 the commit history cannot prove prospective critique or failing-first ordering; it is self-reported in artifacts committed together with source. RV01 and the combined 1490c amendment do show prospective-first commit order.

#176 and #216 have no standalone critique file (embedded). #176 and #74 negative/mutation controls are not tracked as reproducible output: #176 used 'temporary scripts, deleted'; #74 mutation controls M1-M8/A1-A4 are text-only, with named adverse outputs held under ROOT rpi-74-2300-evidence (not read here).

#176 plan promised a 'changed as-of' control; the artifacts record it did not fail for 2026-12-01 (cohort does not move), yet the changes file states 'No divergence from the plan'. The test name contains 'as_of' while as-of is pinned by builder args. Wording discrepancy, not a source defect.

Plan checkboxes disagree with state/changes: 82-2250 all four unchecked, 82-1112 Phase 4 unchecked, combined phases 2-4 unchecked, #176 all unchecked, #216 all unchecked while changes say P01/P02 done; #74 all checked. Consistent with the original Review treating markers as maintained-by-state.

#176's Review states it did not read tracking files; #82-1112 RV-01 Low was routed to later work and closed only by RV01; RV-02 whitespace was corrected after Review without re-review; combined F6 evidence gap was closed post-Review by adding core-skip-classes.out.

Bare assert in the #176 runbook_five_homes helper (core test_generated_dataset.py ~lines 42-49) is relied on by the malformed-table test via AssertionError. Matches the original Low finding; not a new severity or a new source claim.

Parent research (2333) said the union takes the FULL tier. Policy amendment A1 (AC-02/A2C-02, critique rejected as conflicting with the confirmed owner decision) set FOCUSED, with escalation on further persisted-SQL, security-control, workflow, manifest, Dockerfile or gate change, and 'doubt takes the full tier'. Child artifacts consistently claim focused tier only: no full gate, hosted CI, SQL Server, API mypy or independent human review. Real SQL Server acceptance of #82 is not claimed (skips are opt-in SQL Server: core 735 run/165 skipped, api 519/268 skipped).

core-tests-after.out (3137 tests, 34 failures + 16 errors): all 50 are test_device_registry_azure (ModuleNotFoundError azure.iot.hub); api-tests-after.out (2825 tests): 10 import errors for playwright. Both match the changes records (environment-only, pre-existing at base).

Recorded as unmet or unproven by the artifacts and preserved: #74 criterion 2 (outcome tuple/G5 untouched; isolation proven for sentinel records only), #176 criteria 1 and 2 unmet, whole-issue #82 and #216 criteria unproven; tests/test_mvp.py fails ruff format --check at base (pre-existing). #74/#82 overlap on test_home_case_api.py is path-level only with disjoint hunks.

Parent research claims 'independent exact-head Pass bounded' for 74/176; those Passes are per-input and bounded, and the partial plan 0048/0055 and the 0042 handoff explicitly state no earlier Pass is reused as acceptance of the new head. The integration0101 handoff (M0 C3 ec25487e2, M1 main c401e5d56) touches test files only for C3 and no #74/#82/#176/#216 scope; no contradiction with the child artifacts was found.
